stories.label: Iran-US-Israel war: Gulf states hit, Hormuz standstill, school toll 153+
stories.summary: Day 2: War spread across Gulf — Iranian missiles killed 9 in Beit Shemesh (deadliest on Israel), 3 in UAE (migrant workers), 1 in Kuwait. Oman, Bahrain, Qatar also hit. 3 US soldiers killed. School death toll now 153+. Shipping at standstill at Hormuz.

stories.label: Khamenei killed: interim council formed, Assembly of Experts hasn't convened
stories.summary: Khamenei confirmed dead. Interim council (Arafi, president, chief justice) leading. Assembly of Experts hasn't convened. Larijani emerging as broker. Street reaction split. China demands ceasefire, calls killing 'unacceptable'.

stories.label: Iran school strike: death toll now 153-185, war crimes evidence mounting
stories.summary: Death toll from school strike rose to 153 (BBC) and 185 schoolgirls (Premium Times). Israel says 'not aware.' Numbers still climbing.

stories.label: Hormuz shipping standstill — tankers hit, global oil supply at risk
stories.summary: Two ships hit near Hormuz. International shipping at standstill. ~20M bpd normally transits. OPEC+ 206K bpd increase is 1% of disrupted flow. Oil prices spiking. Fuel-importing nations in Africa and South Asia hardest hit.

stories.label: Gaza sealed: Rafah shut again, all crossings closed, 37 aid orgs halted
stories.summary: Israel closed ALL crossings in West Bank and Gaza including Rafah (reopened just 1 month ago). Al-Aqsa and Ibrahimi mosques shut during Ramadan. Dialysis patients stranded. Palestinians returning from Umrah blocked at Jordan border. 37 aid orgs still halted. Collective punishment under Iran war cover.

stories.label: Pakistan erupts: 12+ killed in protests, curfew, army deployed
stories.summary: 12+ dead (10 Karachi, 2 Islamabad). UN offices torched in GB. Curfew in Skardu. Army called in. Section 144 across Punjab. 10M Pakistani workers in Gulf now in missile zones.

stories.label: US intelligence shared Khamenei location with Israel, enabling strike
stories.summary: US officials disclosed Khamenei's location to Israel. May violate Executive Order 12333. Accountability unresolved.

stories.label: Anthropic rejects Pentagon — CEO says no to dropping AI safeguards
stories.summary: Anthropic rejected Pentagon deadline. OpenAI publicly supported Anthropic against supply chain risk designation. Outcome of Hegseth's threat still unclear.

stories.label: Mass graves found in eastern DRC after M23 withdrawal from Uvira
stories.summary: Congolese authorities and civil society found mass graves in areas vacated by Rwanda-backed M23 rebels near Uvira. Evidence of atrocities while world watches Iran.

stories.label: Argentina: Milei passes labor reform + lowers criminal age to 14
stories.summary: Biggest labor law overhaul in decades. Loosens protections, reduces severance, lowers employer taxes. Criminal age lowered to 14. Homelessness up 30% in BA despite macro stabilization.

stories.label: Kenya rolls out free six-month HIV prevention injection
stories.summary: Kenya among first countries to roll out lenacapavir — twice-yearly HIV prevention injection, free of charge. Replaces daily pill that many struggle to maintain.

stories.label: Biology: growing tissues deliberately crack to build functional organs
stories.summary: Quanta: growing tissues crack, break, and dissociate to form structures that later withstand immense forces. Counter-intuitive finding with implications for regenerative medicine.

stories.label: Islamic State using AI to resurrect dead leaders — platforms failing
stories.summary: IS using generative AI to create synthetic media of dead leaders for recruitment. Filming propaganda in Roblox as 'digital Jihad.' Platforms failing to detect and moderate.

stories.label: North Korea condemns Iran strikes: geopolitical bloc crystallising
stories.summary: North Korea called attacks 'illegal aggression.' Russia-North Korea-Iran bloc alignment deepening.

stories.label: World-first: stem cells treat spina bifida in the womb
stories.summary: First-in-human fetal stem cell therapy for spina bifida. Published in Nature.

stories.label: Fungicide health effects persist 20 generations in rats
stories.summary: Nature: single fungicide exposure caused health effects persisting 20 generations via epigenetic inheritance.

stories.label: Syria three-front crisis — al-Hol, Assad remnants, IS threats
stories.summary: Syria fighting on three fronts. Iran war may divert attention. IS exploitation of vacuum likely.

stories.label: Myanmar junta bombs Rakhine — war continues with minimal attention
stories.summary: Military air strikes killed 17 at Rakhine village market. Further obscured by Iran war.

stories.label: Zimbabwe bans all raw mineral and lithium exports
stories.summary: Zimbabwe ban on raw minerals and lithium concentrate exports. Africa's largest lithium reserves.

stories.label: Israeli forces fired 900+ bullets killing 15 Gaza medics
stories.summary: Forensic investigation found 900+ bullets fired at aid workers.

stories.label: Sudan war — fading from attention as Iran dominates
stories.summary: Not covered this cycle. Iran war dominating UNSC bandwidth. Crisis continues.

stories.label: Pakistan multi-front crisis — border war + Iran war fallout
stories.summary: Pakistan dealing with Iran war fallout domestically while border clashes continue.

stories.label: Sickle cell gene therapy — $2.2M cure inaccessible in Africa
stories.summary: Casgevy costs $2.2M. 80% of cases in sub-Saharan Africa. Contrast with Kenya lenacapavir rollout.

stories.label: FBI subpoenas X for Grok prompts in deepfake case
stories.summary: First known case of law enforcement using legal process to get AI prompts as evidence.

stories.label: US orders diplomats to fight data sovereignty worldwide
stories.summary: State Department ordered diplomats to oppose data localization laws worldwide.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia war — Russian missile strikes hit 3-year peak in February
stories.summary: AFP: Russian overnight missile strikes hit 3-year peak in Feb. Russia attention split between Ukraine and Iran. Belgium seized suspected shadow fleet tanker. Not covered this cycle — needs return.

stories.label: Iran-US nuclear talks — ENDED: talks collapsed into war
stories.summary: Superseded by iran-us-israel-war. Talks collapsed into open war.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — fading as Iran war reshapes trade
stories.summary: Fading. Iran war reshaping trade dynamics.

stories.label: ICC prosecution: Duterte drew up death lists
stories.summary: Fading. ICC hearing in procedural phase.

stories.label: Mexico CJNG crisis — aftermath of El Mencho death
stories.summary: Fading. Situation reportedly stabilized.

stories.label: Philippines EDSA 40th anniversary protests
stories.summary: Thousands protested on 40th EDSA anniversary.

stories.label: Sri Lanka arrests ex-intelligence chief over Easter bombings
stories.summary: Seven years of impunity broken.

stories.label: 6.5 million in Somalia face severe hunger
stories.summary: 6.5M Somalis face severe hunger. Al-Shabaab blocking aid.

stories.label: WiseTech cuts 2,000 jobs — AI replaces engineers
stories.summary: WiseTech cutting one-third of workforce attributing layoffs to AI.
